newsitem.title: USA: Taiwan to tender up to 80,000 T US wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to tender up to 80,000 T US wheat - trade.

text.p: Taiwan is expected to tender on Thursday night for at least 80,000 tonnes U.S. wheat, U.S. exporters said.
But another exporter said the shipment was more and amounted to 92,000 tonnes of various U.S. wheats.
The 80,000-tonne tender is divided into two lots of 40,000 tonnes each -- one lot set for November 20-December 10 arrival and another lot slated for November 30-December 20 arrival.
The first shipment would include 24,500 tonnes U.S. dark northern spring wheat, 11,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter and 4,500 tonnes U.S. white wheat.
The second shipment would include 23,100 tonnes DNS, 10,200 tonnes HRW and 6,700 tonnes white wheat.
